name: Shapechange

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Turn into any creature you have seen with a Challenge Rating up to your level (not a Construct or Undead), changing forms as a Magic action.
text: You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the first form's Hit Points and use its statistics, but keep your creature type, alignment, personality, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, proficiencies, ability to communicate and Spellcasting. Your gear falls or resizes to fit, as you choose.
